title: Fix consoleRunWorker app_test FakeClient constructor for context arg
description: CI failure: dashboard/amplify/functions/consoleRunWorker/app_test.py uses FakeClient constructor that only accepts api_url, but app._resolve_client now passes context as well. Update test double to accept context and assert account_key wiring.

comments.author: derek.norrbom
comments.text:
Updated `dashboard/amplify/functions/consoleRunWorker/app_test.py` test double to match new client constructor:

- `FakeClient.__init__` now accepts `api_url` and `context` keyword args.
- Test now sets `PLEXUS_ACCOUNT_KEY` and asserts context wiring (`context.account_key`).

Validation:
- `pytest -q dashboard/amplify/functions/consoleRunWorker/app_test.py::test_resolve_client_uses_iam_auth_without_api_key` passed.
